sv2.name: Makuhita

sv2.name: Hariyama
sv2.effect: It loves challenging others to tests of strength. It has the power to stop a train with a slap.

sv2.name: Croagunk

sv2.name: Toxicroak
sv2.effect: Swaying and dodging the attacks of its foes, it weaves its flexible body in close, then lunges out with its poisonous claws.

sv2.name: Rockruff
sv2.effect: This Pokémon is very friendly when it's young. Its disposition becomes vicious once it matures, but it never forgets the kindness of its master.

sv2.name: Falinks

sv2.name: Sneasel
sv2.effect: This cunning Pokémon hides under the cover of darkness, waiting to attack its prey.

sv2.name: Weavile
sv2.effect: Evolution made it even more devious. It communicates by clawing signs in boulders.

sv2.name: Tyranitar
sv2.effect: Extremely strong, it can change the landscape. It is so insolent that it doesn't care about others.

sv2.name: Sableye
sv2.effect: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.

sv2.name: Seviper

sv2.name: Deino

sv2.name: Zweilous

sv2.name: Hydreigon

sv2.name: Wingull
sv2.effect: It soars high in the sky, riding on updrafts like a glider. It carries food tucked in its bill.

sv2.name: Pelipper

sv2.name: Slakoth
sv2.effect: It sleeps for 20 hours every day. Making drowsy those that see it is one of its abilities.

sv2.name: Vigoroth
sv2.effect: Its stress level rises if it cannot keep moving constantly. Too much stress makes it feel sick.

sv2.name: Slaking

sv2.name: Fletchling
sv2.effect: This Pokémon is normally calm, but once it enters battle, its hormonal balance changes and it becomes aggressive.

sv2.name: Rookidee

sv2.name: Corvisquire

sv3.effect: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.

sv3.name: Ninetales
sv3.effect: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

sv3.name: Palafin
sv3.effect: This Pokémon's ancient genes have awakened. It is now so extraordinarily strong that it can easily lift a cruise ship with one fin.

sv3.name: Bellibolt
sv3.effect: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly-button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.

sv3.name: Cleffa
sv3.effect: Because of its unusual, starlike silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

sv3.name: Larvitar
sv3.effect: Born deep underground, this Pokémon becomes a pupa after eating enough dirt to make a mountain.

sv3.name: Houndour
sv3.effect: It is smart enough to hunt in packs. It uses a variety of cries for communicating with others.

sv3.name: Scizor
sv3.effect: This Pokémon's pincers, which contain steel, can crush any hard object they get ahold of into bits.

sv3.name: Varoom
sv3.effect: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.

sv3.name: Pidgey
sv3.effect: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict. If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.

sv3.name: Pidgeotto
sv3.effect: Very protective of its sprawling territorial area, this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

sv3.name: Lechonk
sv3.effect: It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn't use it for anything other than foraging.

mcd23.name: Sprigatito
mcd23.effect: It's fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.

mcd23.name: Fuecoco
mcd23.effect: Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco's head and flickers to and fro.

mcd23.name: Quaxly
mcd23.effect: This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distance lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repeals water and grime.

mcd23.name: Cetoddle
mcd23.effect: It lives in frigid regions in pods of five or so individuals. It loves the minerals found in snow and ice.

mcd23.name: Cetitan
mcd23.effect: Ice energy builds up in the horn on its upper jaw, causing the horn to reach cryogenic temperatures that freeze its surroundings.

mcd23.name: Pikachu
mcd23.effect: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

mcd23.name: Pawmi
mcd23.effect: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

mcd23.name: Kilowattrel
mcd23.effect: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.

mcd23.name: Flittle
mcd23.effect: Flittle's toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon's belly.

mcd23.name: Sandaconda
mcd23.effect: It will expand its body as much as it can and then contract itself, blasting out sand with enough force to wash away a dump truck.

mcd23.name: Klawf
mcd23.effect: Klawf hangs upside-down from the cliffs, waiting for prey. But Klawf can't remain in this position for long because its blood rushes to its head.

mcd23.name: Blissey
mcd23.effect: The eggs it lays are filled with happiness. Eating even one bite will bring a smile to anyone.

mcd23.name: Tandemaus
mcd23.effect: The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.

mcd23.name: Cyclizar
mcd23.effect: It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a human. The rider's body heat warms Cyclizar's back and lifts the Pokémon's spirit.

mcd23.name: Kirlia
mcd23.effect: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

sv3pt5.name: Bulbasaur
sv3pt5.effect: While it is young, it uses the nutrients that are stored in the seed on its back in order to grow.

sv3pt5.name: Ivysaur
sv3pt5.effect: Exposure to sunlight adds to its strength. Sunlight also makes the bud on its back grow larger.

sv3pt5.name: Venusaur ex
sv3pt5.effect: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

sv3pt5.name: Charmander
sv3pt5.effect: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

sv3pt5.name: Charmeleon
sv3pt5.effect: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

sv3pt5.name: Charizard ex
sv3pt5.effect: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

sv3pt5.name: Squirtle
sv3pt5.effect: When it feels threatened, it draws its limbs inside its shell and sprays water from its mouth.

sv3pt5.name: Wartortle
sv3pt5.effect: It cleverly controls its furry ears and tail to maintain its balance while swimming.

sv3pt5.name: Blastoise ex
sv3pt5.effect: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

sv3pt5.name: Caterpie
sv3pt5.effect: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

sv3pt5.name: Metapod
sv3pt5.effect: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender. It can't withstand a harsh attack.

sv3pt5.name: Butterfree
sv3pt5.effect: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.

sv3pt5.name: Weedle
sv3pt5.effect: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.

sv3pt5.name: Kakuna
sv3pt5.effect: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.

sv3pt5.name: Beedrill
sv3pt5.effect: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

sv3pt5.name: Pidgey
sv3pt5.effect: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict. If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.

sv3pt5.name: Pidgeotto
sv3pt5.effect: Very protective of its sprawling territorial area, this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

sv3pt5.name: Pidgeot
sv3pt5.effect: It spreads its gorgeous wings widely to intimidate enemies. It races through the skies at Mach-2 speed.

sv3pt5.name: Rattata
sv3pt5.effect: This Pokémon is common but hazardous. Its sharp incisors can easily cut right through hard wood.

sv3pt5.name: Raticate
sv3pt5.effect: Its whiskers are essential for maintaining its balance. No matter how friendly you are, it will get angry and bite you if you touch its whiskers.

sv3pt5.name: Spearow
sv3pt5.effect: Due to its short wings, it can't fly long distances. It wanders about restlessly and pecks at bug Pokémon.

sv3pt5.name: Fearow
sv3pt5.effect: Carrying food through Fearow's territory is dangerous. It will snatch the food away from you in a flash!

sv3pt5.name: Ekans
sv3pt5.effect: The eggs of bird Pokémon are its favorite food. It swallows eggs whole, so sometimes an egg gets stuck, and Ekans faints.

sv3pt5.name: Arbok ex
sv3pt5.effect: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

sv3pt5.name: Pikachu
sv3pt5.effect: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

sv3pt5.name: Raichu
sv3pt5.effect: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

sv3pt5.name: Sandshrew
sv3pt5.effect: It burrows into the ground to create its nest. If hard stones impede its tunneling, it uses its sharp claws to shatter them and then carries on digging.

sv3pt5.name: Sandslash
sv3pt5.effect: It climbs trees by hooking on with its sharp claws. Sandslash shares the berries it gathers, dropping them down to Sandshrew waiting below the tree.

sv3pt5.name: Nidoran ♀
sv3pt5.effect: It uses its hard incisor teeth to crush and eat berries. The tip of a female Nidoran's horn is a bit more rounded than the tip of a male's horn.

sv3pt5.name: Nidorina
sv3pt5.effect: If the group is threatened, these Pokémon will band together to assault enemies with a chorus of ultrasonic waves.

sv3pt5.name: Nidoqueen
sv3pt5.effect: It pacifies offspring by placing them in the gaps between the spines on its back. The spines will never secrete poison while young are present.

sv3pt5.name: Nidoran ♂
sv3pt5.effect: Small but brave, this Pokémon will hold its ground and even risk its life in battle to protect the female it's friendly with.

sv3pt5.name: Nidorino
sv3pt5.effect: It's nervous and quick to act aggressively. The potency of its poison increases along with the level of adrenaline present in its body.

sv3pt5.name: Nidoking
sv3pt5.effect: Nidoking prides itself on its strength. It's forceful and spirited in battle, making use of its thick tail and diamond-crushing horn.

sv3pt5.name: Clefairy
sv3pt5.effect: Its adorable behavior and cry make it highly popular. However, this cute Pokémon is rarely found.

sv3pt5.name: Clefable
sv3pt5.effect: Their ears are sensitive enough to hear a pin drop from over a mile away, so they're usually found in quiet places.

sv3pt5.name: Vulpix
sv3pt5.effect: As each tail grows, its fur becomes more lustrous. When held, it feels slightly warm.

sv3pt5.name: Ninetales ex
sv3pt5.effect: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

sv3pt5.name: Jigglypuff
sv3pt5.effect: When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

sv3pt5.name: Wigglytuff ex
sv3pt5.effect: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

sv3pt5.name: Zubat
sv3pt5.effect: Zubat live in caves, down where the sun's light won't reach. In the morning, they gather together to keep each other warm as they sleep.

sv3pt5.name: Golbat
sv3pt5.effect: Its feet are tiny, but this Pokémon walks skillfully. It sneaks up on sleeping prey before sinking in its fangs and slurping up blood.

sv3pt5.name: Oddish
sv3pt5.effect: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

sv3pt5.name: Gloom
sv3pt5.effect: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.

sv3pt5.name: Vileplume
sv3pt5.effect: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

sv3pt5.name: Paras
sv3pt5.effect: The mushrooms, known as tochukaso, are controlling the bug. Even if the bug bugs the mushrooms, they tell it to bug off.

sv3pt5.name: Parasect
sv3pt5.effect: The bug is mostly dead, with the mushroom on its back having become the main body. If the mushroom comes off, the bug stops moving.

sv3pt5.name: Venonat
sv3pt5.effect: Poison oozes from all over its body. It catches small bug Pokémon at night that are attracted by light.

sv3pt5.name: Venomoth
sv3pt5.effect: The wings are covered with dustlike scales. Every time it flaps its wings, it looses highly toxic dust.

sv3pt5.name: Diglett
sv3pt5.effect: It lives about one yard underground, where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears aboveground.

sv3pt5.name: Dugtrio
sv3pt5.effect: Its three heads bob separately up and down to loosen the soil nearby, making it easier for it to burrow.

sv3pt5.name: Meowth
sv3pt5.effect: All it does is sleep during the daytime. At night, it patrols its territory with its eyes aglow.

sv3pt5.name: Persian
sv3pt5.effect: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.

sv3pt5.name: Psyduck
sv3pt5.effect: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.

sv3pt5.name: Golduck
sv3pt5.effect: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins to glow.

sv3pt5.name: Mankey
sv3pt5.effect: It lives in groups in the treetops. If it loses sight of its group, it becomes infuriated by its loneliness.

sv3pt5.name: Primeape
sv3pt5.effect: It becomes wildly furious if it even senses someone looking at it. It chases anyone that meets its glare.

sv3pt5.name: Growlithe
sv3pt5.effect: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

sv3pt5.name: Arcanine
sv3pt5.effect: An ancient picture scroll shows that people were captivated by its movement as it ran through prairies.

sv3pt5.name: Poliwag
sv3pt5.effect: In rivers with fast-flowing water, this Pokémon will cling to a rock by using its thick lips, which act like a suction cup.

sv3pt5.name: Poliwhirl
sv3pt5.effect: This Pokémon's sweat is a slimy mucus. When captured, Poliwhirl can slither from its enemies' grasp and escape.

sv3pt5.name: Poliwrath
sv3pt5.effect: Poliwrath is skilled at both swimming and martial arts. It uses its well-trained arms to dish out powerful punches.

sv3pt5.name: Abra
sv3pt5.effect: Abra can teleport in its sleep. Apparently the more deeply Abra sleeps, the farther its teleportations go.

sv3pt5.name: Kadabra
sv3pt5.effect: This Pokémon's telekinesis is immensely powerful. To prepare for evolution, Kadabra stores up psychic energy in the star on its forehead.

sv3pt5.name: Alakazam ex
sv3pt5.effect: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

sv3pt5.name: Machop
sv3pt5.effect: Always brimming with power, it passes time by lifting boulders. Doing so makes it even stronger.

sv3pt5.name: Machoke
sv3pt5.effect: Its formidable body never gets tired. It helps people by doing work such as the moving of heavy goods.

sv3pt5.name: Machamp
sv3pt5.effect: With four arms that react more quickly than it can think, it can execute many punches at once.

sv3pt5.name: Bellsprout
sv3pt5.effect: Its bud looks like a human face. Because of the bud, it is rumored to be a type of legendary mandrake plant.

sv3pt5.name: Weepinbell
sv3pt5.effect: It spits out Poison Powder to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of Acid.

sv3pt5.name: Victreebel
sv3pt5.effect: Once ingested into this Pokémon's body, even the hardest object will melt into nothing.

sv3pt5.name: Tentacool
sv3pt5.effect: This Pokémon is mostly made of water. A Tentacool out in the ocean is very hard to spot, because its body blends in with the sea.

sv3pt5.name: Tentacruel
sv3pt5.effect: Its 80 tentacles can stretch and shrink freely. Tentacruel ensnares prey in a net of spread-out tentacles, delivering venomous stings to its catch.

sv3pt5.name: Geodude
sv3pt5.effect: It uses both hands to climb precipitous cliffs. People who see it in action have been known to take up bouldering.

sv3pt5.name: Graveler
sv3pt5.effect: It travels by rolling down cliffs. If it falls into a river, it will explode with its last gasp.

sv3pt5.name: Golem ex
sv3pt5.effect: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

sv3pt5.name: Ponyta
sv3pt5.effect: If you've been accepted by Ponyta, its burning mane is mysteriously no longer hot to the touch.

sv3pt5.name: Rapidash
sv3pt5.effect: The fastest runner becomes the leader, and it decides the herd's pace and direction of travel.

sv3pt5.name: Slowpoke
sv3pt5.effect: It is incredibly slow and dopey. It takes five seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.

sv3pt5.name: Slowbro
sv3pt5.effect: When a Slowpoke went hunting in the sea, its tail was bitten by a Shellder. That made it evolve into Slowbro.

sv3pt5.name: Magnemite
sv3pt5.effect: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.

sv3pt5.name: Magneton
sv3pt5.effect: Three Magnemite are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.

sv3pt5.name: Farfetch'd
sv3pt5.effect: They use a plant stalk as a weapon, but not all of them use it in the same way. Several distinct styles of stalk fighting have been observed.

sv3pt5.name: Doduo
sv3pt5.effect: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.

sv3pt5.name: Dodrio
sv3pt5.effect: An odd species that is rarely found. The three heads respectively represent joy, sadness, and anger.

sv3pt5.name: Seel
sv3pt5.effect: Thanks to its thick fat, cold seas don't bother it at all, but it gets tired pretty easily in warm waters.

sv3pt5.name: Dewgong
sv3pt5.effect: It sunbathes on the beach after meals. The rise in its body temperature helps its digestion.

sv3pt5.name: Grimer
sv3pt5.effect: Born from sludge, these Pokémon now gather in polluted places and increase the bacteria in their bodies.

sv3pt5.name: Muk
sv3pt5.effect: It's thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.

sv3pt5.name: Shellder
sv3pt5.effect: It is encased in a shell that is harder than diamond. Inside, however, it is surprisingly tender.

sv3pt5.name: Cloyster
sv3pt5.effect: Cloyster that live in seas with harsh tidal currents grow large, sharp spikes on their shells.

sv3pt5.name: Gastly
sv3pt5.effect: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

sv3pt5.name: Haunter
sv3pt5.effect: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

sv3pt5.name: Gengar
sv3pt5.effect: To steal the life of its target, it slips into the prey's shadow and silently waits for an opportunity.

sv3pt5.name: Onix
sv3pt5.effect: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.

sv3pt5.name: Drowzee
sv3pt5.effect: It remembers every dream it eats. It rarely eats the dreams of adults because children's are much tastier.

sv3pt5.name: Hypno
sv3pt5.effect: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of psi moves, such as Hypnosis and Confusion.

sv3pt5.name: Krabby
sv3pt5.effect: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.

sv3pt5.name: Kingler
sv3pt5.effect: Its oversized claw is very powerful, but when it's not in battle, the claw just gets in the way.

sv3pt5.name: Voltorb
sv3pt5.effect: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

sv3pt5.name: Electrode
sv3pt5.effect: The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets. But this also makes it more likely to explode.

sv3pt5.name: Exeggcute
sv3pt5.effect: These Pokémon get nervous when they're not in a group of six. The minute even one member of the group goes missing, Exeggcute become cowardly.

sv3pt5.name: Exeggutor
sv3pt5.effect: When they work together, Exeggutor's three heads can put out powerful psychic energy. Cloudy days make this Pokémon sluggish.

sv3pt5.name: Cubone
sv3pt5.effect: This Pokémon wears the skull of its deceased mother. Sometimes Cubone's dreams make it cry, but each tear Cubone sheds makes it stronger.

sv3pt5.name: Marowak
sv3pt5.effect: When this Pokémon evolved, the skull of its mother fused to it. Marowak's temperament also turned vicious at the same time.

sv3pt5.name: Hitmonlee
sv3pt5.effect: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

sv3pt5.name: Hitmonchan
sv3pt5.effect: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

sv3pt5.name: Lickitung
sv3pt5.effect: Bug Pokémon are Lickitung's main food source. This Pokémon paralyzes its prey with a lick from its long tongue, then swallows the prey whole.

sv3pt5.name: Koffing
sv3pt5.effect: Its body is full of poisonous gas. It floats into garbage dumps, seeking out the fumes of raw, rotting trash.

sv3pt5.name: Weezing
sv3pt5.effect: Very rarely, a sudden mutation can result in two small Koffing twins becoming conjoined as a Weezing.

sv3pt5.name: Rhyhorn
sv3pt5.effect: It can remember only one thing at a time. Once it starts rushing, it forgets why it started.

sv3pt5.name: Rhydon
sv3pt5.effect: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

sv3pt5.name: Chansey
sv3pt5.effect: This kindly Pokémon lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.

sv3pt5.name: Tangela
sv3pt5.effect: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon's true appearance remains a mystery.

clb.name: Starmie

clb.name: Gyarados
clb.effect: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

clb.name: Lapras

clb.effect: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.

clb.name: Hypno

clb.name: Mr. Mime

clv.effect: One solid blow from its horns is enough to split apart a large tree. Its greatest rival in Alola is Vikavolt.

clv.name: Sandshrew
clv.effect: It lives in areas of limited rainfall. When danger approaches, it curls up into a ball to protect its soft stomach.

clv.name: Sandslash
clv.effect: Its claws and horns often break off. The broken claws and horns can be used to carve plows for tilling farm fields.

clv.name: Onix
clv.effect: It usually lives underground. It searches for food while boring its way through the ground at 50 miles per hour.

clv.name: Hitmonlee
clv.effect: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

clv.name: Hitmonchan
clv.effect: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

clv.name: Doduo
clv.effect: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.

clv.name: Dodrio
clv.effect: It collects data and plans three times as wisely, but it may think too much and fall into a state of immobility.

clv.name: Chansey
clv.effect: A rare and elusive Pokémon that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to catch it.

sv4pt5.name: Pineco
sv4pt5.effect: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.

sv4pt5.name: Maractus
sv4pt5.effect: Once each year, this Pokémon scatters its seeds. They're jam-packed with nutrients, making them a precious food source out in the desert.

sv4pt5.name: Toedscool
sv4pt5.effect: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

sv4pt5.name: Toedscruel ex
sv4pt5.effect: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

sv4pt5.effect: Tera: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's). Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

sv4pt5.name: Charmander
sv4pt5.effect: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

sv4pt5.name: Charmeleon
sv4pt5.effect: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

sv4pt5.name: Magmar
sv4pt5.effect: These Pokémon's bodies are constantly burning. Magmar are feared as one of the causes behind fires.

sv4pt5.name: Magmortar
sv4pt5.effect: Living in the crater of a volcano has caused this Pokémon's body to resemble its environment— it has an organ similar to a magma chamber.

sv4pt5.name: Numel
sv4pt5.effect: Magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit courses through its body. When it grows cold, the magma hardens and slows it.

sv4pt5.name: Camerupt
sv4pt5.effect: It lives in the crater of a volcano. It is well known that the humps on its back erupt every 10 years.

sv4pt5.name: Heat Rotom
sv4pt5.effect: If the convection microwave oven is not working properly, then the Rotom inhabiting it will become lethargic.

sv4pt5.name: Charcadet
sv4pt5.effect: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

sv4pt5.name: Armarouge
sv4pt5.effect: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

sv4pt5.name: Lapras
sv4pt5.effect: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

sv4pt5.name: Frigibax
sv4pt5.effect: Frigibax absorbs heat through its dorsal fin and converts the heat into ice energy. The higher the temperature, the more energy Frigibax stores.

sv4pt5.name: Pikachu
sv4pt5.effect: ﻿When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

sv4pt5.name: Raichu
sv4pt5.effect: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

sv4pt5.name: Chinchou
sv4pt5.effect: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

sv4pt5.name: Lanturn
sv4pt5.effect: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.

sv4pt5.name: Kilowattrel
sv4pt5.effect: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.

sv4pt5.name: Exeggcute
sv4pt5.effect: These Pokémon get nervous when they're not in a group of six. The minute even one member of the group goes missing, Exeggcute become cowardly.

sv4pt5.name: Exeggutor
sv4pt5.effect: When they work together, Exeggutor's three heads can put out powerful psychic energy. Cloudy days make this Pokémon sluggish.

sv4pt5.name: Natu
sv4pt5.effect: Because its wings aren't yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.

sv4pt5.name: Xatu
sv4pt5.effect: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun's movement all day.

sv4pt5.name: Ralts
sv4pt5.effect: The horns on its head provide a strong power that enables it to sense people's emotions.

sv4pt5.name: Kirlia
sv4pt5.effect: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

sv4pt5.name: Gardevoir ex
sv4pt5.effect: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

sv4pt5.name: Chimecho
sv4pt5.effect: Emitting ultrasonic cries, it floats on winds to travel great distances.

sv4pt5.name: Mime Jr.
sv4pt5.effect: In an attempt to confuse its enemy, it mimics the enemy's movements. Then it wastes no time in making itself scarce!

sv4pt5.name: Woobat
sv4pt5.effect: It emits ultrasonic waves as it flutters about, searching for its prey—bug Pokémon.

sv4pt5.name: Swoobat
sv4pt5.effect: The auspicious shape of this Pokémon's nose apparently led some regions to consider Swoobat a symbol of good luck.

sv4pt5.name: Cottonee
sv4pt5.effect: Weaving together the cotton of both Cottonee and Eldegoss produces exquisite cloth that's highly prized by many luxury brands.

sv4pt5.name: Whimsicott
sv4pt5.effect: As long as this Pokémon bathes in sunlight, its cotton keeps growing. If too much cotton fluff builds up, Whimsicott tears it off and scatters it.

sv4pt5.name: Dedenne
sv4pt5.effect: It's small and its electricity-generating organ is not fully developed, so it uses its tail to absorb electricity from people's homes and charge itself.

sv4pt5.name: Mimikyu
sv4pt5.effect: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

sv4pt5.name: Fidough
sv4pt5.effect: This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough's breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon's vicinity.

sv4pt5.name: Dachsbun
sv4pt5.effect: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon's body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.

sv4pt5.name: Ceruledge
sv4pt5.effect: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.

sv4pt5.name: Flittle
sv4pt5.effect: Flittle's toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon's belly.

sv4pt5.name: Greavard
sv4pt5.effect: This friendly Pokémon doesn't like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.

sv4pt5.name: Houndstone
sv4pt5.effect: A lovingly mourned Pokémon was reborn as Houndstone. It doesn't like anyone touching the protuberance atop its head.

sv4pt5.name: Gimmighoul
sv4pt5.effect: This Pokémon was born inside a treasure chest about 1,500 years ago. It sucks the life-force out of scoundrels who try to steal the treasure.

sv4pt5.name: Mankey
sv4pt5.effect: It is extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment, then thrashing away the next instant.

sv4pt5.name: Primeape
sv4pt5.effect: Some researchers theorize that Primeape remains angry even when inside a Poké Ball.

sv4pt5.name: Annihilape
sv4pt5.effect: It imbues its fists with the power of the rage that it kept hidden in its heart. Opponents struck by these imbued fists will be shattered to their core.

sv4pt5.name: Phanpy
sv4pt5.effect: This Pokémon lives and nests on a riverbank. After playing in the mud, it won't be able to settle down unless it washes its body.

sv4pt5.name: Donphan
sv4pt5.effect: Donphan is covered in tough hide, so even being hit by a car won't faze this Pokémon. However, it is extremely susceptible to rain.

sv4pt5.name: Barboach
sv4pt5.effect: Its two whiskers provide a sensitive radar. Even in muddy waters, it can detect its prey's location.

sv4pt5.name: Clobbopus
sv4pt5.effect: Its tentacles tear off easily, but it isn't alarmed when that happens—it knows they'll grow back. It's about as smart as a three-year-old.

sv4pt5.name: Grapploct
sv4pt5.effect: Searching for an opponent to test its skills against, it emerges onto land. Once the battle is over, it returns to the sea.

sv4pt5.name: Great Tusk ex
sv4pt5.effect: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

sv4pt5.effect: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

sv4pt5.name: Haunter
sv4pt5.effect: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

sv4pt5.name: Gengar
sv4pt5.effect: To steal the life of its target, it slips into the prey's shadow and silently waits for an opportunity.

sv4pt5.name: Paldean Wooper
sv4pt5.effect: After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

sv4pt5.name: Paldean Clodsire ex
sv4pt5.effect: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

sv4pt5.name: Scraggy
sv4pt5.effect: It protects itself with its durable skin. It's thought that this Pokémon will evolve once its skin has completely stretched out.

sv4pt5.name: Scrafty
sv4pt5.effect: While mostly known for having the temperament of an aggressive ruffian, this Pokémon takes very good care of its family, friends, and territory.

sv4pt5.name: Maschiff
sv4pt5.effect: It always scowls in an attempt to make opponents take it seriously, but even crying children will burst into laughter when they see Maschiff's face.

sv4pt5.name: Mabosstiff
sv4pt5.effect: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

sv4pt5.name: Varoom
sv4pt5.effect: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.

sv4pt5.name: Revavroom
sv4pt5.effect: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders— now numbering eight—to generate energy.

sv4pt5.name: Iron Treads ex
sv4pt5.effect: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

sv4pt5.name: Gholdengo
sv4pt5.effect: Its body seems to be made up of 1,000 coins. This Pokémon gets along well with others and is quick to make friends with anybody.

sv4pt5.name: Noibat
sv4pt5.effect: This Pokémon emits ultrasonic waves from its large ears to search for fruit to eat. It mistakes Applin for its food.

sv4pt5.name: Noivern ex
sv4pt5.effect: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

sv4pt5.name: Cyclizar
sv4pt5.effect: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.

sv4pt5.name: Lechonk
sv4pt5.effect: It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn't use it for anything other than foraging.

sv4pt5.name: Oinkologne
sv4pt5.effect: This Pokémon sends a flowerlike scent wafting about. Well-developed muscles in its legs allow it to leap more than 16 feet with no trouble at all.

sv4pt5.name: Tandemaus
sv4pt5.effect: Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them.

sv4pt5.name: Maushold
sv4pt5.effect: The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight.

sv4pt5.name: Squawkabilly ex
sv4pt5.effect: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

sv4pt5.name: Artazon
sv4pt5.effect: Once during each player's turn, that player may search their deck for a Basic Pokémon that doesn't have a Rule Box and put it onto their Bench. Then, that player shuffles their deck. (Pokémon ex, Pokémon V, etc. have Rule Boxes.) You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.

sv4pt5.name: Atticus
sv4pt5.effect: You can use this card only if your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned. Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 7 cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

sv4pt5.name: Clive
sv4pt5.effect: Your opponent reveals their hand, and you draw 2 cards for each Supporter card you find there. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

sv4pt5.name: Electric Generator
sv4pt5.effect: Look at the top 5 cards of your deck and attach up to 2 Basic Lightning Energy cards you find there to your Benched Lightning Pokémon in any way you like. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

sv4pt5.name: Iono
sv4pt5.effect: Each player shuffles their hand and puts it on the bottom of their deck. If either player put any cards on the bottom of their deck in this way, each player draws a card for each of their remaining Prize cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

sv4pt5.name: Moonlit Hill
sv4pt5.effect: Once during each player's turn, that player may discard a Basic Psychic Energy card from their hand in order to heal 30 damage from each of their Pokémon. You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.

sv4pt5.name: Nemona
sv4pt5.effect: Draw 3 cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

sv4pt5.name: Nemona's Backpack
sv4pt5.effect: Put up to 2 Nemona cards from your discard pile into your hand. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

sv4pt5.name: Nest Ball
sv4pt5.effect: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

sv4pt5.name: Paldean Student
sv4pt5.effect: Search your deck for a Pokémon that doesn't have a Rule Box, reveal it, and put it into your hand. For each Paldean Student card (not including this card) in your discard pile, you may search for an additional Pokémon in this way. Then, shuffle your deck. (Pokémon ex, Pokémon V, etc. have Rule Boxes.) You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

sv4pt5.name: Paldean Student
sv4pt5.effect: Search your deck for a Pokémon that doesn't have a Rule Box, reveal it, and put it into your hand. For each Paldean Student card (not including this card) in your discard pile, you may search for an additional Pokémon in this way. Then, shuffle your deck. (Pokémon ex, Pokémon V, etc. have Rule Boxes.) You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

sv4pt5.name: Professor's Research
sv4pt5.effect: Discard your hand and draw 7 cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

sv4pt5.name: Professor's Research
sv4pt5.effect: Discard your hand and draw 7 cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

sv4pt5.name: Rare Candy
sv4pt5.effect: Choose 1 of your Basic Pokémon in play. If you have a Stage 2 card in your hand that evolves from that Pokémon, put that card onto the Basic Pokémon to evolve it, skipping the Stage 1. You can't use this card during your first turn or on a Basic Pokémon that was put into play this turn. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

sv4pt5.name: Technical Machine: Crisis Punch
sv4pt5.effect: The Pokémon this card is attached to can use the attack on this card. (You still need the necessary Energy to use this attack.) If this card is attached to 1 of your Pokémon, discard it at the end of your turn. You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

sv4pt5.name: Ultra Ball
sv4pt5.effect: You can use this card only if you discard 2 other cards from your hand. Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

sv4pt5.name: Oddish
sv4pt5.effect: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

sv4pt5.name: Gloom
sv4pt5.effect: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.

sv4pt5.name: Vileplume
sv4pt5.effect: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

sv4pt5.name: Scyther
sv4pt5.effect: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.

sv4pt5.name: Hoppip
sv4pt5.effect: This Pokémon is blown across vast distances by the wind. It is unclear where the Hoppip of Paldea originally came from.

sv4pt5.name: Skiploom
sv4pt5.effect: Skiploom enthusiasts can apparently tell where a Skiploom was born by the scent drifting from the flower on the Pokémon's head.

sv4pt5.name: Jumpluff
sv4pt5.effect: Jumpluff travels on seasonal winds. Once its cotton spores run out, its journey ends, as does its life.

sv4pt5.name: Pineco
sv4pt5.effect: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.

sv4pt5.name: Snover
sv4pt5.effect: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain's lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.

sv4pt5.name: Abomasnow
sv4pt5.effect: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards.

sv4pt5.name: Smoliv
sv4pt5.effect: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

sv4pt5.name: Dolliv
sv4pt5.effect: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.

sv4pt5.name: Arboliva
sv4pt5.effect: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.

sv4pt5.name: Toedscool
sv4pt5.effect: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

sv4pt5.name: Capsakid
sv4pt5.effect: Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy because they include the shed front teeth of Capsakid among their ingredients.

sv4pt5.name: Scovillain
sv4pt5.effect: The red head converts spicy chemicals into fire energy and blasts the surrounding area with a super spicy stream of flame.

sv4pt5.name: Rellor
sv4pt5.effect: This Pokémon creates a mud ball by mixing sand and dirt with psychic energy. It treasures its mud ball more than its own life.

sv4pt5.name: Charmander
sv4pt5.effect: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

sv4pt5.name: Charmeleon
sv4pt5.effect: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

sv4pt5.name: Paldean Tauros
sv4pt5.effect: People call this kind of Tauros the Blaze Breed due to the hot air it snorts from its nostrils. Its three tails are intertwined.

sv4pt5.name: Entei
sv4pt5.effect: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

sv4pt5.name: Oricorio
sv4pt5.effect: This Pokémon is incredibly popular, possibly because its passionate dancing is a great match with the temperament of Paldean people.

sv4pt5.name: Charcadet
sv4pt5.effect: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

sv4pt5.name: Armarouge
sv4pt5.effect: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

sv4pt5.name: Slowpoke
sv4pt5.effect: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.

sv4pt5.name: Slowbro
sv4pt5.effect: If the tail-biting Shellder is thrown off in a harsh battle, this Pokémon reverts to being an ordinary Slowpoke.

sv4pt5.name: Staryu
sv4pt5.effect: Fish Pokémon nibble at it, but Staryu isn't bothered. Its body regenerates quickly, even if part of it is completely torn off.

sv4pt5.name: Starmie
sv4pt5.effect: Starmie swims by spinning its body at high speed. As this Pokémon cruises through the ocean, it absorbs tiny plankton.

sv4pt5.name: Paldean Tauros
sv4pt5.effect: It swims by jetting water from its horns. The most notable characteristic of the Aqua Breed is its high body fat, which allows it to float easily.

sv4pt5.name: Wiglett
sv4pt5.effect: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

sv4pt5.name: Wugtrio
sv4pt5.effect: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey, then drags the prey into its den.

sv4pt5.name: Finizen
sv4pt5.effect: It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.

sv4pt5.name: Palafin
sv4pt5.effect: This Pokémon's ancient genes have awakened. It is now so extraordinarily strong that it can easily lift a cruise ship with one fin.

sv4pt5.name: Veluza
sv4pt5.effect: When Veluza discards unnecessary flesh, its mind becomes honed and its psychic power increases. The spare flesh has a mild but delicious flavor.

sv4pt5.name: Dondozo
sv4pt5.effect: This Pokémon is a glutton, but it's bad at getting food. It teams up with a Tatsugiri to catch prey.

sv4pt5.name: Tatsugiri
sv4pt5.effect: This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.

sv4pt5.name: Frigibax
sv4pt5.effect: Frigibax absorbs heat through its dorsal fin and converts the heat into ice energy. The higher the temperature, the more energy Frigibax stores.

sv4pt5.name: Arctibax
sv4pt5.effect: Arctibax freezes the air around it, protecting its face with an ice mask and turning its dorsal fin into a blade of ice.

sv4pt5.name: Baxcalibur
sv4pt5.effect: This Pokémon blasts cryogenic air out from its mouth. This air can instantly freeze even liquid-hot lava.

sv4pt5.name: Pikachu
sv4pt5.effect: ﻿When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

sv4pt5.name: Raichu
sv4pt5.effect: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

sv4pt5.name: Voltorb
sv4pt5.effect: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

sv4pt5.name: Electrode
sv4pt5.effect: The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets. But this also makes it more likely to explode.

sv4pt5.name: Shinx
sv4pt5.effect: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

sv4pt5.name: Luxio
sv4pt5.effect: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

sv4pt5.name: Luxray
sv4pt5.effect: It can see clearly through walls to track down its prey and seek its lost young.

sv4pt5.name: Pachirisu
sv4pt5.effect: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

sv4pt5.name: Thundurus
sv4pt5.effect: As it flies around, it shoots lightning all over the place and causes forest fires. It is therefore disliked.

sv4pt5.name: Toxel
sv4pt5.effect: It has no problem drinking dirty water. An organ inside Toxel's body filters such water into a poisonous liquid that is harmless to Toxel.

sv4pt5.name: Toxtricity
sv4pt5.effect: Many youths admire the way this Pokémon listlessly picks fights and keeps its cool no matter what opponent it faces.

sv4pt5.name: Pawmi
sv4pt5.effect: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

sv4pt5.name: Pawmo
sv4pt5.effect: Pawmo uses a unique fighting technique in which it uses its forepaws to strike foes and zap them with electricity from its paw pads simultaneously.

sv4pt5.name: Pawmot
sv4pt5.effect: Pawmot's fluffy fur acts as a battery. It can store the same amount of electricity as an electric car.

sv4pt5.name: Wattrel
sv4pt5.effect: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

sv4pt5.name: Kilowattrel
sv4pt5.effect: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.

sv4pt5.name: Wigglytuff
sv4pt5.effect: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a body slam.

sv4pt5.name: Abra
sv4pt5.effect: Abra can teleport in its sleep. Apparently the more deeply Abra sleeps, the farther its teleportations go.

sv4pt5.name: Kadabra
sv4pt5.effect: This Pokémon's telekinesis is immensely powerful. To prepare for evolution, Kadabra stores up psychic energy in the star on its forehead.

sv4pt5.name: Cleffa
sv4pt5.effect: Because of its unusual, starlike silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

sv4pt5.name: Natu
sv4pt5.effect: Because its wings aren't yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.

sv4pt5.name: Xatu
sv4pt5.effect: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun's movement all day.

sv4pt5.name: Ralts
sv4pt5.effect: The horns on its head provide a strong power that enables it to sense people's emotions.

sv4pt5.name: Kirlia
sv4pt5.effect: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

sv4pt5.name: Drifloon
sv4pt5.effect: It is whispered that any child who mistakes Drifloon for a balloon and holds on to it could wind up missing.

sv4pt5.name: Drifblim
sv4pt5.effect: It can generate and release gas within its body. That's how it can control the altitude of its drift.

sv4pt5.name: Mime Jr.
sv4pt5.effect: In an attempt to confuse its enemy, it mimics the enemy's movements. Then it wastes no time in making itself scarce!

sv4pt5.name: Spiritomb
sv4pt5.effect: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.

sv4pt5.name: Klefki
sv4pt5.effect: In the past, noble families entrusted their vault keys to a Klefki. They passed the Klefki down through the generations, taking good care of it.

sv4pt5.name: Mimikyu
sv4pt5.effect: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

sv4pt5.name: Dachsbun
sv4pt5.effect: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon's body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.

sv4pt5.name: Ceruledge
sv4pt5.effect: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.

sv4pt5.name: Rabsca
sv4pt5.effect: The body that supports the ball barely moves. Therefore, it is thought that the true body of this Pokémon is actually inside the ball.

sv4pt5.name: Flittle
sv4pt5.effect: Flittle's toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon's belly.

sv4pt5.name: Tinkatink
sv4pt5.effect: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.

sv4pt5.name: Tinkatuff
sv4pt5.effect: This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and Bisharp, gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer.

sv4pt5.name: Tinkaton
sv4pt5.effect: This intelligent Pokémon has a very daring disposition. It knocks rocks into the sky with its hammer, aiming for flying Corviknight.

sv4pt5.name: Houndstone
sv4pt5.effect: A lovingly mourned Pokémon was reborn as Houndstone. It doesn't like anyone touching the protuberance atop its head.

sv4pt5.name: Mankey
sv4pt5.effect: It is extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment, then thrashing away the next instant.

sv4pt5.name: Primeape
sv4pt5.effect: Some researchers theorize that Primeape remains angry even when inside a Poké Ball.

sv4pt5.name: Annihilape
sv4pt5.effect: It imbues its fists with the power of the rage that it kept hidden in its heart. Opponents struck by these imbued fists will be shattered to their core.

sv4pt5.name: Paldean Tauros
sv4pt5.effect: This kind of Tauros, known as the Combat Breed, is distinguished by its thick, powerful muscles and its fierce disposition.

sv4pt5.name: Riolu
sv4pt5.effect: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

sv4pt5.name: Lucario
sv4pt5.effect: It's said that no foe can remain invisible to Lucario, since it can detect auras—even those of foes it could not otherwise see.

sv4pt5.name: Hawlucha
sv4pt5.effect: Its elegant finishing moves—performed by nimbly leaping around using its wings—are polished in the forest where it was born and raised.

sv4pt5.name: Nacli
sv4pt5.effect: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.

sv4pt5.name: Naclstack
sv4pt5.effect: This Pokémon dry cures its prey by spraying salt over them. The curing process steals away the water in the prey's body.

sv4pt5.name: Garganacl
sv4pt5.effect: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.

sv4pt5.name: Glimmet
sv4pt5.effect: It absorbs nutrients from cave walls. The petals it wears are made of crystallized poison.

sv4pt5.name: Paldean Wooper
sv4pt5.effect: After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

sv4pt5.name: Murkrow
sv4pt5.effect: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

sv4pt5.name: Sneasel
sv4pt5.effect: This cunning Pokémon hides under the cover of darkness, waiting to attack its prey.

sv4pt5.name: Weavile
sv4pt5.effect: Evolution made it even more devious. It communicates by clawing signs in boulders.

sv4pt5.name: Sableye
sv4pt5.effect: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.

sv4pt5.name: Pawniard
sv4pt5.effect: Pawniard will fearlessly challenge even powerful foes. In a pinch, it will cling to opponents and pierce them with the blades all over its body.

sv4pt5.name: Bisharp
sv4pt5.effect: This Pokémon commands a group of several Pawniard. Groups that are defeated in territorial disputes are absorbed by the winning side.

sv4pt5.name: Kingambit
sv4pt5.effect: Only a Bisharp that stands above all others in its vast army can evolve into Kingambit.

sv4pt5.name: Mabosstiff
sv4pt5.effect: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

sv4pt5.name: Shroodle
sv4pt5.effect: Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will sink its sharp, poison-soaked front teeth into any that anger it, causing paralysis in the object of its ire.

sv4pt5.name: Grafaiai
sv4pt5.effect: The color of the poisonous saliva depends on what the Pokémon eats. Grafaiai covers its fingers in its saliva and draws patterns on trees in forests.

sv4pt5.name: Scizor
sv4pt5.effect: This Pokémon's pincers, which contain steel, can crush any hard object they get ahold of into bits.

sv4pt5.name: Varoom
sv4pt5.effect: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.

sv4pt5.name: Revavroom
sv4pt5.effect: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders— now numbering eight—to generate energy.

sv4pt5.name: Noibat
sv4pt5.effect: This Pokémon emits ultrasonic waves from its large ears to search for fruit to eat. It mistakes Applin for its food.

sv4pt5.name: Cyclizar
sv4pt5.effect: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.

sv4pt5.name: Pidgey
sv4pt5.effect: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict. If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.

sv4pt5.name: Pidgeotto
sv4pt5.effect: Very protective of its sprawling territorial area, this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

sv4pt5.name: Jigglypuff
sv4pt5.effect: When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

sv4pt5.name: Doduo
sv4pt5.effect: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.

sv4pt5.name: Dodrio
sv4pt5.effect: An odd species that is rarely found. The three heads respectively represent joy, sadness, and anger.

sv4pt5.name: Ditto
sv4pt5.effect: Its transformation ability is perfect. However, if made to laugh, it can't maintain its disguise.

sv4pt5.name: Snorlax
sv4pt5.effect: This Pokémon's stomach is so strong, even eating moldy or rotten food will not affect it.

sv4pt5.name: Wingull
sv4pt5.effect: It soars high in the sky, riding on updrafts like a glider. It carries food tucked in its bill.

sv4pt5.name: Pelipper
sv4pt5.effect: It is a flying transporter that carries small Pokémon in its beak. It bobs on the waves to rest its wings.

sv4pt5.name: Skwovet
sv4pt5.effect: No matter how much it stuffs its belly with food, it is always anxious about getting hungry again. So, it stashes berries in its cheeks and tail.

sv4pt5.name: Greedent
sv4pt5.effect: This Pokémon makes off with heaps of fallen berries by wrapping them in its tail, which is roughly twice the length of its body.

sv4pt5.name: Lechonk
sv4pt5.effect: It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn't use it for anything other than foraging.

sv4pt5.name: Oinkologne
sv4pt5.effect: This Pokémon sends a flowerlike scent wafting about. Well-developed muscles in its legs allow it to leap more than 16 feet with no trouble at all.

sv4pt5.name: Tandemaus
sv4pt5.effect: Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them.

sv4pt5.name: Maushold
sv4pt5.effect: The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight.

sv4pt5.name: Flamigo
sv4pt5.effect: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.

sv4pt5.effect: Tera: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's). Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
