zsv10pt5.name: Snivy
zsv10pt5.effect: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

zsv10pt5.name: Servine
zsv10pt5.effect: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.

zsv10pt5.name: Serperior ex
zsv10pt5.effect: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

zsv10pt5.name: Pansage
zsv10pt5.effect: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.

zsv10pt5.name: Simisage
zsv10pt5.effect: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

zsv10pt5.name: Petilil
zsv10pt5.effect: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.

zsv10pt5.name: Lilligant
zsv10pt5.effect: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.

zsv10pt5.name: Maractus
zsv10pt5.effect: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.

zsv10pt5.name: Karrablast
zsv10pt5.effect: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

zsv10pt5.name: Foongus
zsv10pt5.effect: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.

zsv10pt5.name: Amoonguss
zsv10pt5.effect: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.

zsv10pt5.name: Victini
zsv10pt5.effect: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

zsv10pt5.name: Darumaka
zsv10pt5.effect: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it falls asleep.

zsv10pt5.name: Darmanitan
zsv10pt5.effect: Its internal fire burns at 2,500° F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.

zsv10pt5.name: Larvesta
zsv10pt5.effect: This Pokémon was believed to have been born from the sun. When it evolves, its entire body is engulfed in flames.

zsv10pt5.name: Volcarona
zsv10pt5.effect: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona's fire provided a replacement for the sun.

zsv10pt5.name: Panpour
zsv10pt5.effect: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

zsv10pt5.name: Simipour
zsv10pt5.effect: The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.

zsv10pt5.name: Tympole
zsv10pt5.effect: They warn others of danger by vibrating their cheeks to create a high-pitched sound.

zsv10pt5.name: Palpitoad
zsv10pt5.effect: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.

zsv10pt5.name: Seismitoad
zsv10pt5.effect: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.

zsv10pt5.name: Tirtouga
zsv10pt5.effect: Restored from a fossil, this Pokémon can dive to depths beyond half a mile.

zsv10pt5.name: Carracosta
zsv10pt5.effect: They can live both in the ocean and on land. A slap from one of them is enough to open a hole in the bottom of a tanker.

zsv10pt5.name: Alomomola
zsv10pt5.effect: The special membrane enveloping Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.

zsv10pt5.name: Cubchoo
zsv10pt5.effect: When it is not feeling well, its mucus gets watery and the power of its Ice-type moves decreases.

zsv10pt5.name: Beartic
zsv10pt5.effect: It can make its breath freeze at will. Very able in the water, it swims around in northern seas and catches prey.

zsv10pt5.name: Cryogonal
zsv10pt5.effect: When its body temperature goes up, it turns into steam and vanishes. When its temperature lowers, it returns to ice.

zsv10pt5.name: Kyurem ex
zsv10pt5.effect: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

zsv10pt5.name: Emolga
zsv10pt5.effect: The energy made in its cheeks' electric pouches is stored inside its membrane and released while it is gliding.

zsv10pt5.name: Tynamo
zsv10pt5.effect: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

zsv10pt5.name: Eelektrik
zsv10pt5.effect: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.

zsv10pt5.name: Eelektross
zsv10pt5.effect: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

zsv10pt5.name: Thundurus
zsv10pt5.effect: Countless charred remains mar the landscape of places through which Thundurus has passed.

zsv10pt5.name: Zekrom ex
zsv10pt5.effect: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

zsv10pt5.name: Munna
zsv10pt5.effect: Munna always float in the air. People whose dreams are eaten by them forget what the dreams had been about.

zsv10pt5.name: Musharna
zsv10pt5.effect: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.

zsv10pt5.name: Solosis
zsv10pt5.effect: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.

zsv10pt5.name: Duosion
zsv10pt5.effect: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.

zsv10pt5.name: Reuniclus
zsv10pt5.effect: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.

zsv10pt5.name: Elgyem
zsv10pt5.effect: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent's brain, causing unendurable headaches.

zsv10pt5.name: Beheeyem
zsv10pt5.effect: It can manipulate an opponent's memory. Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three different-colored fingers.

zsv10pt5.name: Golett
zsv10pt5.effect: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.

zsv10pt5.name: Golurk
zsv10pt5.effect: It flies across the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.

zsv10pt5.name: Meloetta ex
zsv10pt5.effect: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

zsv10pt5.name: Drilbur
zsv10pt5.effect: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.

zsv10pt5.name: Excadrill ex
zsv10pt5.effect: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

zsv10pt5.name: Timburr
zsv10pt5.effect: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.

zsv10pt5.name: Gurdurr
zsv10pt5.effect: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

zsv10pt5.name: Conkeldurr
zsv10pt5.effect: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.

zsv10pt5.name: Throh
zsv10pt5.effect: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.

zsv10pt5.name: Dwebble
zsv10pt5.effect: This Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.

zsv10pt5.name: Crustle
zsv10pt5.effect: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.

zsv10pt5.name: Landorus
zsv10pt5.effect: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as “The Guardian of the Fields.”

zsv10pt5.name: Venipede
zsv10pt5.effect: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.

zsv10pt5.name: Whirlipede
zsv10pt5.effect: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.

zsv10pt5.name: Scolipede
zsv10pt5.effect: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.

zsv10pt5.name: Sandile
zsv10pt5.effect: They live buried in the sands of the desert. The sun-warmed sands prevent their body temperature from dropping.

zsv10pt5.name: Krokorok
zsv10pt5.effect: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.

zsv10pt5.name: Krookodile
zsv10pt5.effect: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.

zsv10pt5.name: Escavalier
zsv10pt5.effect: They fly around at high speed, striking with their pointed spears. Even when in trouble, they face opponents bravely.

zsv10pt5.name: Klink
zsv10pt5.effect: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

zsv10pt5.name: Klang
zsv10pt5.effect: By changing the direction in which it rotates, it communicates its feelings to others. When angry, it rotates faster.

zsv10pt5.name: Klinklang
zsv10pt5.effect: Its red core functions as an energy tank. It fires the charged energy through its spikes into an area.

zsv10pt5.name: Pawniard
zsv10pt5.effect: Blades comprise this Pokémon's entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.

zsv10pt5.name: Bisharp
zsv10pt5.effect: It leads a group of Pawniard. It battles to become the boss, but will be driven from the group if it loses.

zsv10pt5.name: Cobalion
zsv10pt5.effect: This legendary Pokémon battled against humans to protect Pokémon. Its personality is calm and composed.

zsv10pt5.name: Genesect ex
zsv10pt5.effect: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

zsv10pt5.name: Axew
zsv10pt5.effect: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.

zsv10pt5.name: Fraxure
zsv10pt5.effect: Since a broken tusk will not grow back, they diligently sharpen their tusks on river rocks after they've been fighting.

zsv10pt5.name: Haxorus
zsv10pt5.effect: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.

zsv10pt5.name: Pidove
zsv10pt5.effect: Each follows its Trainer's orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.

zsv10pt5.name: Tranquill
zsv10pt5.effect: It can return to its Trainer's location regardless of the distance separating them.

zsv10pt5.name: Unfezant
zsv10pt5.effect: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females' flying abilities surpass those of the males.

zsv10pt5.name: Audino
zsv10pt5.effect: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.

zsv10pt5.name: Minccino
zsv10pt5.effect: They greet one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.

zsv10pt5.name: Cinccino
zsv10pt5.effect: Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.

zsv10pt5.name: Rufflet
zsv10pt5.effect: They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.

zsv10pt5.name: Braviary
zsv10pt5.effect: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.

zsv10pt5.name: Air Balloon
zsv10pt5.effect: The Retreat Cost of the Pokémon this card is attached to is ColorlessColorless less. You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached. Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.

zsv10pt5.name: Antique Cover Fossil
zsv10pt5.effect: Play this card as if it were a 60-HP Basic Colorless Pokémon. This card can't be affected by any Special Conditions and can't retreat.  At any time during your turn, you may discard this card from play. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

zsv10pt5.name: Energy Coin
zsv10pt5.effect: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, search your deck for a Basic Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

zsv10pt5.name: Fennel
zsv10pt5.effect: Heal 40 damage from each of your Pokémon. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

zsv10pt5.name: N's Plan
zsv10pt5.effect: Move up to 2 Energy from your Benched Pokémon to your Active Pokémon. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

zsv10pt5.name: Pokégear 3.0
zsv10pt5.effect: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Supporter card you find there and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

zsv10pt5.name: Professor's Research
zsv10pt5.effect: Discard your hand and draw 7 cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

zsv10pt5.name: Prism Energy
zsv10pt5.effect: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Colorless Energy.  If this card is attached to a Basic Pokémon, this card provides every type of Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time.

zsv10pt5.name: Snivy
zsv10pt5.effect: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

zsv10pt5.name: Servine
zsv10pt5.effect: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.

zsv10pt5.name: Pansage
zsv10pt5.effect: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.

zsv10pt5.name: Simisage
zsv10pt5.effect: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

zsv10pt5.name: Petilil
zsv10pt5.effect: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.

zsv10pt5.name: Lilligant
zsv10pt5.effect: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.

zsv10pt5.name: Maractus
zsv10pt5.effect: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.

zsv10pt5.name: Karrablast
zsv10pt5.effect: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

zsv10pt5.name: Foongus
zsv10pt5.effect: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.

zsv10pt5.name: Amoonguss
zsv10pt5.effect: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.

zsv10pt5.name: Darumaka
zsv10pt5.effect: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it falls asleep.

zsv10pt5.name: Darmanitan
zsv10pt5.effect: Its internal fire burns at 2,500° F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.

zsv10pt5.name: Larvesta
zsv10pt5.effect: This Pokémon was believed to have been born from the sun. When it evolves, its entire body is engulfed in flames.

zsv10pt5.name: Volcarona
zsv10pt5.effect: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona's fire provided a replacement for the sun.

zsv10pt5.name: Panpour
zsv10pt5.effect: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

zsv10pt5.name: Simipour
zsv10pt5.effect: The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.

zsv10pt5.name: Tympole
zsv10pt5.effect: They warn others of danger by vibrating their cheeks to create a high-pitched sound.

zsv10pt5.name: Palpitoad
zsv10pt5.effect: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.

zsv10pt5.name: Seismitoad
zsv10pt5.effect: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.

zsv10pt5.name: Tirtouga
zsv10pt5.effect: Restored from a fossil, this Pokémon can dive to depths beyond half a mile.

zsv10pt5.name: Carracosta
zsv10pt5.effect: They can live both in the ocean and on land. A slap from one of them is enough to open a hole in the bottom of a tanker.

zsv10pt5.name: Alomomola
zsv10pt5.effect: The special membrane enveloping Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.

zsv10pt5.name: Cubchoo
zsv10pt5.effect: When it is not feeling well, its mucus gets watery and the power of its Ice-type moves decreases.

zsv10pt5.name: Beartic
zsv10pt5.effect: It can make its breath freeze at will. Very able in the water, it swims around in northern seas and catches prey.

zsv10pt5.name: Cryogonal
zsv10pt5.effect: When its body temperature goes up, it turns into steam and vanishes. When its temperature lowers, it returns to ice.

zsv10pt5.name: Emolga
zsv10pt5.effect: The energy made in its cheeks' electric pouches is stored inside its membrane and released while it is gliding.

zsv10pt5.name: Tynamo
zsv10pt5.effect: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

zsv10pt5.name: Eelektrik
zsv10pt5.effect: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.

zsv10pt5.name: Eelektross
zsv10pt5.effect: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

zsv10pt5.name: Munna
zsv10pt5.effect: Munna always float in the air. People whose dreams are eaten by them forget what the dreams had been about.

zsv10pt5.name: Musharna
zsv10pt5.effect: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.

zsv10pt5.name: Solosis
zsv10pt5.effect: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.

zsv10pt5.name: Duosion
zsv10pt5.effect: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.

zsv10pt5.name: Elgyem
zsv10pt5.effect: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent's brain, causing unendurable headaches.

zsv10pt5.name: Beheeyem
zsv10pt5.effect: It can manipulate an opponent's memory. Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three different-colored fingers.

zsv10pt5.name: Golett
zsv10pt5.effect: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.

zsv10pt5.name: Golurk
zsv10pt5.effect: It flies across the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.

zsv10pt5.name: Drilbur
zsv10pt5.effect: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.

zsv10pt5.name: Timburr
zsv10pt5.effect: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.

zsv10pt5.name: Gurdurr
zsv10pt5.effect: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

zsv10pt5.name: Conkeldurr
zsv10pt5.effect: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.

zsv10pt5.name: Throh
zsv10pt5.effect: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.

zsv10pt5.name: Dwebble
zsv10pt5.effect: This Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.

zsv10pt5.name: Crustle
zsv10pt5.effect: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.

zsv10pt5.name: Landorus
zsv10pt5.effect: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as “The Guardian of the Fields.”

zsv10pt5.name: Venipede
zsv10pt5.effect: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.

zsv10pt5.name: Whirlipede
zsv10pt5.effect: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.

zsv10pt5.name: Scolipede
zsv10pt5.effect: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.

zsv10pt5.name: Sandile
zsv10pt5.effect: They live buried in the sands of the desert. The sun-warmed sands prevent their body temperature from dropping.

zsv10pt5.effect: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

zsv10pt5.name: Zekrom ex
zsv10pt5.effect: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

rsv10pt5.name: Sewaddle
rsv10pt5.effect: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.

rsv10pt5.name: Swadloon
rsv10pt5.effect: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

rsv10pt5.name: Leavanny
rsv10pt5.effect: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using the cutters on its arms and sticky silk.

rsv10pt5.name: Cottonee
rsv10pt5.effect: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.

rsv10pt5.name: Whimsicott ex
rsv10pt5.effect: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

rsv10pt5.name: Deerling
rsv10pt5.effect: The color and scent of their fur changes to match the mountain grass. When they sense hostility, they hide in the grass.

rsv10pt5.name: Sawsbuck
rsv10pt5.effect: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck's horns.

rsv10pt5.name: Shelmet
rsv10pt5.effect: When attacked, it defends itself by closing the lid of its shell. It can spit a sticky, poisonous liquid.

rsv10pt5.name: Accelgor
rsv10pt5.effect: When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in many layers of thin membrane.

rsv10pt5.name: Virizion
rsv10pt5.effect: This Pokémon fought humans in order to protect its friends. Legends about it continue to be passed down.

rsv10pt5.name: Tepig
rsv10pt5.effect: It can deftly dodge its foe's attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

rsv10pt5.name: Pignite
rsv10pt5.effect: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

rsv10pt5.name: Emboar
rsv10pt5.effect: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

rsv10pt5.name: Pansear
rsv10pt5.effect: When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600° F. It uses its tuft to roast berries.

rsv10pt5.name: Simisear
rsv10pt5.effect: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.

rsv10pt5.name: Litwick
rsv10pt5.effect: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.

rsv10pt5.name: Lampent
rsv10pt5.effect: This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen.

rsv10pt5.name: Chandelure
rsv10pt5.effect: It absorbs a spirit, which it then burns. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.

rsv10pt5.name: Heatmor
rsv10pt5.effect: It breathes through a hole in its tail while it burns with an internal fire. Durant is its prey.

rsv10pt5.name: Reshiram ex
rsv10pt5.effect: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

rsv10pt5.name: Oshawott
rsv10pt5.effect: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

rsv10pt5.name: Dewott
rsv10pt5.effect: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.

rsv10pt5.name: Samurott
rsv10pt5.effect: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

rsv10pt5.name: Basculin
rsv10pt5.effect: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they'll start fighting instantly. These Pokémon are very hostile.

rsv10pt5.name: Ducklett
rsv10pt5.effect: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They swim around in the water eating their favorite food--peat moss.

rsv10pt5.name: Swanna
rsv10pt5.effect: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

rsv10pt5.name: Vanillite
rsv10pt5.effect: The temperature of their breath is -58° F. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.

rsv10pt5.name: Vanillish
rsv10pt5.effect: Snowy mountains are this Pokémon's habitat. During an ancient ice age, they moved to southern areas.

rsv10pt5.name: Vanilluxe
rsv10pt5.effect: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and attack their foes with violent blizzards.

rsv10pt5.name: Keldeo ex
rsv10pt5.effect: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

rsv10pt5.name: Blitzle
rsv10pt5.effect: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.

rsv10pt5.name: Zebstrika
rsv10pt5.effect: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

rsv10pt5.name: Joltik
rsv10pt5.effect: Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique for sucking electricity from the outlets in houses.

rsv10pt5.name: Galvantula
rsv10pt5.effect: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.

rsv10pt5.name: Stunfisk
rsv10pt5.effect: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

rsv10pt5.name: Woobat
rsv10pt5.effect: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

rsv10pt5.name: Swoobat
rsv10pt5.effect: It emits sound waves of various frequencies from its nose, including some powerful enough to destroy rocks.

rsv10pt5.name: Sigilyph
rsv10pt5.effect: They never vary the route they fly, because their memories of guarding an ancient city remain steadfast.

rsv10pt5.name: Yamask
rsv10pt5.effect: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.

rsv10pt5.name: Cofagrigus
rsv10pt5.effect: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.

rsv10pt5.name: Gothita
rsv10pt5.effect: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

rsv10pt5.name: Gothorita
rsv10pt5.effect: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.

rsv10pt5.name: Gothitelle
rsv10pt5.effect: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.

rsv10pt5.name: Frillish
rsv10pt5.effect: With its thin, veil-like arms wrapped around the body of its opponent, it sinks to the ocean floor.

rsv10pt5.name: Jellicent ex
rsv10pt5.effect: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

rsv10pt5.name: Roggenrola
rsv10pt5.effect: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.

rsv10pt5.name: Boldore
rsv10pt5.effect: When it overflows with power, the orange crystal on its body glows. It looks for underground water in caves.

rsv10pt5.name: Gigalith
rsv10pt5.effect: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.

rsv10pt5.name: Sawk
rsv10pt5.effect: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train.

rsv10pt5.name: Archen
rsv10pt5.effect: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.

rsv10pt5.name: Archeops
rsv10pt5.effect: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.

rsv10pt5.name: Mienfoo
rsv10pt5.effect: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.

rsv10pt5.name: Mienshao
rsv10pt5.effect: It wields the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.

rsv10pt5.name: Terrakion
rsv10pt5.effect: This Pokémon came to the defense of Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.

rsv10pt5.name: Purrloin
rsv10pt5.effect: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can't help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.

rsv10pt5.name: Liepard
rsv10pt5.effect: These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur.

rsv10pt5.name: Scraggy
rsv10pt5.effect: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

rsv10pt5.name: Scrafty
rsv10pt5.effect: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.

rsv10pt5.name: Trubbish
rsv10pt5.effect: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.

rsv10pt5.name: Garbodor

rsv10pt5.name: Sewaddle
rsv10pt5.effect: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.

rsv10pt5.name: Swadloon
rsv10pt5.effect: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

rsv10pt5.name: Leavanny
rsv10pt5.effect: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using the cutters on its arms and sticky silk.

rsv10pt5.name: Cottonee
rsv10pt5.effect: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.

rsv10pt5.name: Deerling
rsv10pt5.effect: The color and scent of their fur changes to match the mountain grass. When they sense hostility, they hide in the grass.

rsv10pt5.name: Sawsbuck
rsv10pt5.effect: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck's horns.

rsv10pt5.name: Shelmet
rsv10pt5.effect: When attacked, it defends itself by closing the lid of its shell. It can spit a sticky, poisonous liquid.

rsv10pt5.name: Accelgor
rsv10pt5.effect: When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in many layers of thin membrane.

rsv10pt5.name: Virizion
rsv10pt5.effect: This Pokémon fought humans in order to protect its friends. Legends about it continue to be passed down.

rsv10pt5.name: Tepig
rsv10pt5.effect: It can deftly dodge its foe's attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

rsv10pt5.name: Pignite
rsv10pt5.effect: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

rsv10pt5.name: Emboar
rsv10pt5.effect: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

rsv10pt5.name: Pansear
rsv10pt5.effect: When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600° F. It uses its tuft to roast berries.

rsv10pt5.name: Simisear
rsv10pt5.effect: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.

rsv10pt5.name: Litwick
rsv10pt5.effect: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.

rsv10pt5.name: Lampent
rsv10pt5.effect: This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen.

rsv10pt5.name: Chandelure
rsv10pt5.effect: It absorbs a spirit, which it then burns. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.

rsv10pt5.name: Heatmor
rsv10pt5.effect: It breathes through a hole in its tail while it burns with an internal fire. Durant is its prey.

rsv10pt5.name: Oshawott
rsv10pt5.effect: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

rsv10pt5.name: Dewott
rsv10pt5.effect: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.

rsv10pt5.name: Samurott
rsv10pt5.effect: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

rsv10pt5.name: Basculin
rsv10pt5.effect: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they'll start fighting instantly. These Pokémon are very hostile.

rsv10pt5.name: Ducklett
rsv10pt5.effect: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They swim around in the water eating their favorite food--peat moss.

rsv10pt5.name: Swanna
rsv10pt5.effect: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

rsv10pt5.name: Vanillite
rsv10pt5.effect: The temperature of their breath is -58° F. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.

rsv10pt5.name: Vanillish
rsv10pt5.effect: Snowy mountains are this Pokémon's habitat. During an ancient ice age, they moved to southern areas.

rsv10pt5.name: Vanilluxe
rsv10pt5.effect: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and attack their foes with violent blizzards.

rsv10pt5.name: Blitzle
rsv10pt5.effect: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.

rsv10pt5.name: Zebstrika
rsv10pt5.effect: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

rsv10pt5.name: Joltik
rsv10pt5.effect: Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique for sucking electricity from the outlets in houses.

rsv10pt5.name: Galvantula
rsv10pt5.effect: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.

rsv10pt5.name: Stunfisk
rsv10pt5.effect: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

rsv10pt5.name: Woobat
rsv10pt5.effect: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

rsv10pt5.name: Swoobat
rsv10pt5.effect: It emits sound waves of various frequencies from its nose, including some powerful enough to destroy rocks.

rsv10pt5.name: Sigilyph
rsv10pt5.effect: They never vary the route they fly, because their memories of guarding an ancient city remain steadfast.

rsv10pt5.name: Yamask
rsv10pt5.effect: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.

rsv10pt5.name: Cofagrigus
rsv10pt5.effect: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.

rsv10pt5.name: Gothita
rsv10pt5.effect: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

rsv10pt5.name: Gothorita
rsv10pt5.effect: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.

rsv10pt5.name: Frillish
rsv10pt5.effect: With its thin, veil-like arms wrapped around the body of its opponent, it sinks to the ocean floor.

rsv10pt5.name: Roggenrola
rsv10pt5.effect: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.

rsv10pt5.name: Boldore
rsv10pt5.effect: When it overflows with power, the orange crystal on its body glows. It looks for underground water in caves.

rsv10pt5.name: Gigalith
rsv10pt5.effect: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.

rsv10pt5.name: Sawk
rsv10pt5.effect: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train.

rsv10pt5.name: Archen
rsv10pt5.effect: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.

rsv10pt5.name: Archeops
rsv10pt5.effect: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.

rsv10pt5.name: Mienfoo
rsv10pt5.effect: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.

rsv10pt5.name: Mienshao
rsv10pt5.effect: It wields the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.

rsv10pt5.name: Terrakion
rsv10pt5.effect: This Pokémon came to the defense of Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.

rsv10pt5.name: Purrloin
rsv10pt5.effect: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can't help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.

rsv10pt5.name: Liepard
rsv10pt5.effect: These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur.

rsv10pt5.name: Scraggy
rsv10pt5.effect: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

rsv10pt5.name: Scrafty
rsv10pt5.effect: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.

me1.name: Bulbasaur
me1.effect: For some time after its birth, it uses the nutrients that are packed into the seed on its back in order to grow.

me1.name: Ivysaur
me1.effect: The more sunlight Ivysaur bathes in, the more strength wells up within it, allowing the bud on its back to grow larger.

me1.name: Mega Venusaur ex
me1.effect: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

me1.name: Exeggcute
me1.effect: If you touch one of Exeggcute's heads, mistaking it for an egg, the other heads will quickly gather and attack you in a swarm.

me1.name: Exeggutor
me1.effect: It is called the Walking Jungle. Each of the nuts has a face and a will of its own.

me1.name: Tangela
me1.effect: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon's true appearance remains a mystery.

me1.name: Tangrowth
me1.effect: Vine growth is accelerated for Tangrowth living in warm climates. If the vines grow long, Tangrowth shortens them by tearing parts of them off.

me1.name: Chikorita
me1.effect: It loves to bask in the sunlight. It uses the leaf on its head to seek out warm places.

me1.name: Bayleef
me1.effect: The spicy scent that wafts from around Bayleef's neck somehow makes those who smell it want to fight.

me1.name: Meganium
me1.effect: Anyone who stands beside it becomes refreshed, just as if they were soaking in the soothing atmosphere of a forest.

me1.name: Shuckle
me1.effect: The berries stored in its vaselike shell eventually become a thick, pulpy juice.

me1.name: Celebi
me1.effect: This Pokémon traveled through time to come from the future. It bolsters grass and trees with its own strength, and it can heal wounds, too.

me1.name: Seedot
me1.effect: To expand its habitat, it pretends to be a nut so that bird Pokémon will pick it up and carry it far away.

me1.name: Nuzleaf
me1.effect: It leads a quiet life deep in the forest. If anything wanders into its territory, Nuzleaf will warn the intruder by sounding its grass flute.

me1.name: Shiftry
me1.effect: It is said that when Shiftry flaps its leafy fans atop ancient trees, chilly winds blow and the season rolls into winter.

me1.name: Nincada
me1.effect: It can sometimes live underground for more than 10 years. It absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees.

me1.name: Ninjask
me1.effect: This Pokémon is so quick, it is said to be able to avoid any attack. It loves to feed on tree sap.

me1.name: Dhelmise
me1.effect: After lowering its anchor, it waits for its prey. It catches large Wailord and drains their life-force.

me1.name: Vulpix
me1.effect: If it is attacked by an enemy that is stronger than itself, it feigns injury to fool the enemy and escapes.

me1.name: Ninetales
me1.effect: Some legends claim that each of its nine tails has its own unique type of special mystical power.

me1.name: Numel
me1.effect: Magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit courses through its body. When it grows cold, the magma hardens and slows it.

me1.name: Mega Camerupt ex
me1.effect: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

me1.name: Litleo
me1.effect: When Litleo are young, female Pyroar will teach them how to hunt. Once the Litleo mature, they will leave the pride and set out on their own.

me1.name: Pyroar
me1.effect: The mane of a male Pyroar heats up to over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit during battle. Merely approaching it will cause severe burns.

me1.name: Volcanion
me1.effect: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.

me1.name: Scorbunny
me1.effect: Once its body has heated up, Scorbunny can use the full extent of its power. That's why it does warm-up exercises.

me1.name: Raboot
me1.effect: Thanks to its soft and fluffy fur, Raboot can easily heat up its fire energy and produce flames with more power.

me1.name: Cinderace
me1.effect: Although Cinderace loses its cool easily, it will battle flawlessly for a Trainer it trusts.

me1.name: Sizzlipede
me1.effect: It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they're well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.

me1.name: Centiskorch
me1.effect: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.

me1.name: Chi-Yu
me1.effect: It controls flames burning at over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit. It casually swims through the sea of lava it creates by melting rock and sand.

me1.name: Mantine
me1.effect: As it majestically swims, it doesn't care if Remoraid attach to it to scavenge for its leftovers.

me1.name: Corphish
me1.effect: It came from overseas. It is a very hardy creature that will quickly proliferate, even in polluted streams.

me1.name: Kyogre
me1.effect: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

me1.name: Snover
me1.effect: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain's lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.

me1.name: Mega Abomasnow ex
me1.effect: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

me1.name: Clauncher
me1.effect: This Pokémon launches water by detonating gas inside its right claw. It snipes flying Pokémon.

me1.name: Clawitzer
me1.effect: Clawitzer can move through the water at a speed of 60 knots by using gas inside its body to expel water from the back of its claw.

me1.name: Sobble
me1.effect: It gets berries to eat by shooting them down with bullets of water it spurts from its mouth. Its aim is perfect.

me1.name: Drizzile
me1.effect: It extends its long, slimy tongue at blinding speeds and finishes off its prey with great skill.

me1.name: Inteleon
me1.effect: It uses special lenses in its eyes to sense things about its opponents—like their body heat—then attacks once it identifies a weak spot.

me1.name: Snom
me1.effect: It eats snow that has accumulated on the ground. It prefers soft, freshly fallen snow, so it will eat its way up a mountain, aiming for the peak.

me1.name: Frosmoth
me1.effect: Frosmoth senses air currents with its antennae. It sends its scales drifting on frigid air, making them fall like snow.

me1.name: Eiscue
me1.effect: On hot days, these Pokémon press their ice cube heads together and pass the time cooling each other down.

me1.name: Magnemite
me1.effect: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.

me1.name: Magneton
me1.effect: Three Magnemite are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.

me1.name: Magnezone
me1.effect: As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémon seems to be receiving signals of unknown origin while transmitting signals of unknown purpose.

me1.name: Raikou
me1.effect: This rough Pokémon stores energy inside its body, then sweeps across the land, shooting off electricity.

me1.name: Electrike
me1.effect: It stores electricity in its fur. It gives off sparks from all over its body in seasons when the air is dry.

me1.name: Mega Manectric ex
me1.effect: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

me1.name: Pachirisu
me1.effect: It's one of the kinds of Pokémon with electric cheek pouches. It shoots charges from its tail.

me1.name: Helioptile
me1.effect: The sun powers this Pokémon's electricity generation. Interruption of that process stresses Helioptile to the point of weakness.

me1.name: Heliolisk
me1.effect: One Heliolisk basking in the sun with its frill outspread is all it would take to produce enough electricity to power a city.

me1.name: Abra
me1.effect: Abra can teleport in its sleep. Apparently the more deeply Abra sleeps, the farther its teleportations go.

me1.name: Kadabra
me1.effect: This Pokémon's telekinesis is immensely powerful. To prepare for evolution, Kadabra stores up psychic energy in the star on its forehead.

me1.name: Alakazam
me1.effect: Alakazam wields potent psychic powers. It's said that this Pokémon used these powers to create the spoons it holds.

me1.name: Jynx
me1.effect: Its strange cries sound like human language. There are some musicians who compose songs for Jynx to sing.

me1.name: Ralts
me1.effect: The horns on its head provide a strong power that enables it to sense people's emotions.

me1.name: Kirlia
me1.effect: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

me1.name: Mega Gardevoir ex
